blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Talisay City Government is preparing additional water distribution measures amid the El Niño, including the deployment of three water tankers, installation of storage tanks in barangays and the use of identified water sources for emergency supply. Mayor Gerald Anthony “Samsam” Gullas said the city is coordinating with all 22 barangays and local water service providers, including the Metropolitan Cebu Water District (MCWD), to prepare for possible water shortages during prolonged dry weather. The preparations are intended to ensure that water can be delivered to communities with limited access to supply, particularly areas that may experience shortages […]...
